# Tediber

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

French direct-to-consumer bedding and furniture brand selling mattresses, bedding packs, bed bases, beds, duvets, pillows, bed linen, children's ranges and sofas online. Its delivery page states delivery to France and to several European countries.
